receiptUri.description: AT-URI of the purchase.receipt this consent record accompanies.

receiptCid.description: CID of the receipt at time of consent. Links consent to a specific, immutable receipt state.

licenseGrantUri.description: AT-URI of the license.terms record the buyer consented to.

licenseGrantCid.description: CID of the license.terms record at time of consent. The buyer agreed to these exact terms — not a future or past version.

buyerDid.description: DID of the buyer. Names the consenting party explicitly, making this a buyer-addressed instrument rather than an anonymous terms snapshot.

consentedAt.description: Timestamp of affirmative consent. Combined with the PDS record's creation timestamp forms a tamper-evident assertion of when consent was given.

appSig.description: Base64url signature by the storefront service keypair (storefrontDid — see purchase.receipt) over SHA-256(buyerDid:licenseGrantCid:receiptCid:consentedAt). All four values are colon-delimited in the order listed. Prevents consent records being fabricated outside the app's trust boundary. Verifiers reconstruct this payload from the consent record's plaintext fields and verify against the public key resolved from storefrontDid — using kid to select the correct historical key if the keypair has been rotated. Immutable.

kid.description: Key identifier for the storefront service keypair that produced appSig. Format: storefront-key-{YYYY-MM-DD} where the date is the keypair's activation date, e.g. storefront-key-2026-08-29. Allows verifiers to select the correct historical key from the storefrontDid DID document verificationMethod array without trying all keys exhaustively. kid is a hint — verifiers still verify cryptographically and should fall back to trying all non-revoked keys if the hinted key fails. Immutable.
